entries.rendered_text: This certificate does not establish that the measured result generalizes to inputs, workloads, or deployments beyond the declared holdout evaluation.
Passing this certificate's evaluation does not establish that the agent would pass a materially different or expanded evaluation.
This certificate does not establish that the certified configuration is the best configuration for production traffic, because production traffic was not the evaluated population.
This certificate does not establish that the certified agent behaves correctly, or as intended, in general; only the declared objectives on the declared holdout were measured.
This certificate does not establish that the certified configuration is statistically better than the alternatives it was evaluated against.
This certificate does not establish that the certified configuration would win again if the evaluation were re-run.
This certificate does not establish that any margin between the certified configuration and a runner-up is meaningful or reliable.
This certificate's statistical language is not established to remain valid if the selection criteria change; a criteria change requires a new certificate.
This certificate does not assess whether the evaluation dataset correctly measures the target task; dataset validity is out of scope for v1.
This certificate does not assess whether the evaluator (judge or scorer) used is a correct or unbiased measure of the metric it reports.
This certificate makes no assertion about safety or harm; only the declared quality objectives were measured.
This certificate does not establish that the holdout population matches, or will continue to match, any other population the agent may encounter.
This certificate does not establish that the certified agent is fit for any particular customer purpose beyond the declared objectives and holdout.
This certificate does not establish a comparison against any configuration that was not itself certified under the same protocol.
The stated interval coverage is nominal, not measured; this certificate does not establish that the true coverage of any interval equals its nominal value.
Pre-registration is not verified by this certificate; ordering evidence is out of scope for v1.
Estimates computed on the selection set are not certified by this document; only the holdout-evaluated objective is certified.
This certificate does not establish, and does not constitute, a cost or latency service-level agreement.
This certificate does not establish that the measured objectives remain stable over time; it reflects a single evaluation at a single point in time.
This certificate covers a single, one-shot use of the holdout split; it does not establish anything about repeated or iterative use of the same holdout.

The verifier recomputes each interval's endpoints from the printed sufficient statistics; that those statistics correctly summarise the underlying observations is the issuer's attestation, not a fact independently verified here.
The committed selection and holdout sets were not opened by this certificate; that they are the declared rule's partition is the issuer's attestation, not a verified fact.
The interval endpoints for quantile objectives are attested from the printed order-statistic record, not independently recomputed from the underlying observations by this certificate.
This certificate does not prove when the split key was fixed relative to any other event; timing of split-key derivation is not established.
Stable references printed on this certificate can correlate certificates that share them, even though the references themselves carry no content; this is disclosed, not concealed.
That no holdout item informed the choice of certified configuration is the issuer's attestation; this certificate does not independently prove holdout non-use.

That each reference on this certificate was server- or issuer-minted, rather than a passthrough of a caller-supplied name, is an issuer obligation this certificate's pattern does not itself enforce or verify.
For the evaluator-score objective, the reported scale is the evaluator's own scale; this certificate does not assess or establish the validity of that evaluator.
